locations: Met object 670896, 2015.300.62, Motsurin Jōtō (Bokusai), Japan 15th century, hanging scroll ink on paper. The circular ink wash and gnarled blossoming branch may suggest Zen enso, Heart Sutra form/emptiness, or enlightenment; the preference of mentor Ikkyū for plum is also a might, not certain intention. The inscription expresses the painter's specific comparison of plum with peony and jasmine.
